input: is there any performance engineering worth doing on any of the tools that get run a lot rewriting in rust or other for example?
follow_up_inputs: write up a report and blog and merge save any unfinished work and give instructions for a future agent to complete it.
task: Find performance work worth doing on frequently run tools; ship the biggest win

doc_friction.issue: nothing at the encoder says its exact bytes are pinned by a committed PNG under gitops/prod/front-door; only the marketing suite finds out
writing.mjs said nothing about how a post should link to the site's own tools; full URLs broke custom-domain builds and relative ones became GitHub links. Now documented at buildWriting

deviations.why: route drew track research; the user's question was platform performance, so the work followed the question. Track recorded as drawn.

merged on the last head's CI plus local checks of the main merge, not a fresh full CI round: main moves several times an hour and each round takes 30-50 min, so a full round would be behind main again (as the validate race showed twice).

notes: Profiled the hot tools before deciding on any rewrite. node build.mjs: 182s, of which 112s zlib.deflateSync level 9 in offline.mjs encodeRaw (~1,450 1200x630 share cards, ~80ms each). Level 6: 11ms/card, +9% bytes. Build now 1m21s; PNG total 74.7MB -> 81.4MB. node --test platform/pages/*.test.mjs: 1159/1159 pass in 8m54s (4 tests doing full builds take 88-182s each; sharing builds across them is the next win). node check.mjs dist: exit 0. allocate.py load_merit_scores via libyaml: 1.36s -> 0.12s, dict identical; test_allocate 73 OK. Other timings: session_gate 6.9s, validate_workflows 4.7s, publish_surface 2.0s, clauses.mjs 1.3s, promptctl route 0.4s; allocate.py 18s warm (12.7s is git deepen of a shallow clone). No tool here is CPU-bound in a way that a Rust rewrite would help more than these fixes. Follow-up: report with next-agent steps at docs/history/pages-build-perf-2026-10-20.md (items A shared test builds, B 281 clauses.mjs workflows, C allocate deepen); post docs/posts/2026-10-20-we-almost-rewrote-it-in-rust.md (writing.test.mjs 8/8, check_md_links ok). Local after fixes: node --test platform/marketing/*.test.mjs platform/pages/*.test.mjs 1437/1437; pytest portfolio/router prompts 162 passed; check.mjs on a fresh build reports 7 problems, all feedback/index.html (from #8723 on main, not this PR). Final: CI on 1d40e0d had every job green except validate (check_venture_regression: main gained interview-content-studio after the push, a race) and gitops (1 failure, test_every_job_that_runs_python_or_node_sets_it_up, red on main and fixed there by #8776). Merged main again (f3cf367c); main had meanwhile landed the same publish-branch stub and entity fixes, so the conflicts took main's side and this PR's diff shrank to its own 9 files. On that head, locally: node --test platform/pages/*.test.mjs platform/marketing/*.test.mjs 1438/1438 (on 1d40e0d); entities, faq-visible, writing, custom-domain 27/27; test_ci_runner sets_it_up 1 passed; check_venture_regression OK; regen --verify 0; promptctl validate ok.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profiling a 3-minute build, benchmarking deflate settings, running the 9-minute suite

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
